waypoints.name: Half Moon Crag
waypoints.note: Confirmed via Mountain Project (exact GPS match to this area's registered location) - granite crag visible from Highway 2, ~45-60min/1,000ft approach through old-growth forest. Routes are short (≤85 ft), so this single verified coordinate serves as both approach reference and topout.

waypoints.name: Tye Road / Old Stevens Pass Highway pullout (near double hairpin turn, ~1.4 mi from US 2)
waypoints.note: Mountain Project gives written directions only ('Hwy 2 to Stevens Pass, take old Stevens Pass Hwy/Tye Rd downhill toward Wellington, pull off just uphill of the double hairpin turn, ~1.4 mi from US2') and does not publish a separate parking GPS pin. This coordinate (matching what's already in our DB) is geographically consistent with that description but is an inferred/estimated pulloff location, not a directly sourced pin.
